stations.title: Old screen
stations.text: Five pieces of state, and a count by hand.

captions: Hesper adds cards on the React order screen, and the header says three lines for two.
The screen keeps its own copies of the order, and the count is kept by hand.
You join React to your store with a hook, then rebuild the screen on it, in three tasks.
Now the header's count comes from the one basket, and it matches.
One store, a screen that draws only what changed, and code the shop can explain.
